title: Philippines' NPC says 11 government agencies have yet to submit full breach reports
summary: The National Privacy Commission (NPC) said 11 government agencies have yet to submit a full breach report, GMA News reports. NPC spokesperson Jose Amelito Belarmino II said 13 government agencies were reportedly hacked, and that failure to submit is already a violation. Gulf News adds that the Department of Migrant Workers was also hacked and must file separately.
plain: The Philippine privacy regulator says 11 government agencies that were reportedly hacked have not yet filed full breach reports. Its spokesperson said not filing is already a violation.
exec: The NPC says 11 hacked government agencies still owe full breach reports; its spokesperson called not submitting one a violation.

sources.name: Gulf News: Philippines: 11 government agencies fail to submit full data-breach reports

evidence.quote: NPC spokesperson Jose Amelito Belarmino II said that a total of 13 government agencies were reportedly hacked.
The National Privacy Commission (NPC) said that 11 government agencies have yet to submit a full breach report

validation.note: GMA Network (gmanetwork.com) and Gulf News (gulfnews.com) each report the NPC spokesperson's 24 November remarks on the 11 agencies; NPC's own page not read.
